description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to add and configure Azure Table Storage-based reminder services in an Orleans application. It provides multiple overloads of the UseAzureTableReminderService method to support different configuration approaches, including direct options, options builder, and connection string.

classes.name: AzureStorageReminderServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to add Azure Table Storage reminder services.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Adds Azure Table Storage-based reminder storage to the service collection with a configuration delegate.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Adds Azure Table Storage-based reminder storage with an options builder configuration.

methods.name: UseAzureTableReminderService
methods.description: Adds Azure Table Storage-based reminder storage using a connection string, automatically configuring the storage client.
